Name: Better Maru Portraits
Author: Milkshxs
Description:
This is a simple Mod that changes Maru's Portraits to be more accurate to her sprites!

To use this mod, simply download it,
unzip,
and place in your mod folder!
And that's all!!

I really hope you guys like these Portraits, they took me a really long time XD but I'm happy with the result!!
If anyone has any suggestions for further Portraits, let me know! :)

Downloads.Description: Just download and unzip into your mod file and they should run properly! Let me know if there are any issues :)

Manifest.Name: Better Maru Portraits
Manifest.Description: Changes Maru's portraits to match her sprites.
